name: NetherSX2 (AetherSX2 fork)

launch.notes: ES-DE: %EMULATOR_NETHERSX2% %ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK% %ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP% %ACTION%=android.intent.action.MAIN %EXTRA_bootPath%=%ROMSAF%. The emulator needs its own folder access to the PS2 games folder (ES-DE ANDROID-DEV.md).

configTarget.notes: Reference only in v1. NetherSX2 is a binary patch of the closed-source AetherSX2 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-patch/main/README.md); its data lives in Android/data (not SAF-grantable) and its setting enums follow an older PCSX2 snapshot, so indices from current PCSX2 (e.g. GSHardwareDownloadMode) may not match. Upstream PCSX2 names per-game files gamesettings/<SERIAL>_<ELF CRC as %08X>.ini, where the CRC is the XOR of all 32-bit words of the boot ELF (ElfObject::GetCRC in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PCSX2/pcsx2/master/pcsx2/Elfheader.cpp). The app shows these values as a manual checklist (uiPath/uiValue).

presets.name: Thor Balanced (manual)
presets.description: Vulkan, 3x native, readbacks disabled. Apply in NetherSX2 > Game Properties (per game) or Settings (global).

values.reason: README FAQ: further optimize by using the Vulkan GPU renderer.
README FAQ: set Hardware Download Mode to Disable Readbacks. Numeric index intentionally not given (fork enum may differ from upstream).
Search snippets for Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 NetherSX2 guides say 3x or 4x suits high-end GPUs (nethersx2.org / gamehelptech.com; not fetchable).

values.uiPath: Settings > Speed Hacks > EE Cycle Rate
values.description: Keep EE cycle rate at default for stability.
values.reason: Search snippet: keep EE Cycle Rate at 100% for stable gameplay; lower only for demanding games (not fetchable). 0 is the upstream default (Pcsx2Config.cpp).

presets.name: Thor Performance (manual)
presets.description: 2x native, readbacks disabled; for heavy games.

manualNotes: Variant choice (README): 4248 (patched) is recommended for Adreno devices; 3668 'Classic' can be faster in some games and should use Threaded Presentation with Vulkan (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-patch/main/README.md).
ARMSX2 (open source, actively developed) is increasingly recommended over NetherSX2 by Thor guides (search snippets); see armsx2.json.
